_: A pin held deliberately, with the reason and a date to look again. Not a
way to silence the check: a waiver past its review_by date is reported as
loudly as an unwaived finding, and the reason is printed every week so the
decision stays visible instead of turning into something nobody remembers

waivers.reason: Rocket.Chat 8.8.1 lists MongoDB 8.0 as the only compatible engine, and MongoDB 8.0 before 8.0.30 refuses to start on Linux kernels 6.19 through 7.0.13 (SERVER-121912, a TCMalloc rseq violation that crashed 8.0+ until MongoDB added the refusal; SERVER-125742 lifts it in 8.0.30, 8.3.9 and 9.0 on kernels 7.0.14 and later). Verified on 2026-09-09 against kernel 7.0.12: 8.0.28, 8.0.29, 8.0.30 and 8.3.9 all exit at startup; 8.2.12 starts only because it predates the guard, not because it is fixed. GitHub's runners are on kernel 6.17, so CI would pass a bump that a modern host refuses. MongoDB 7.0 is supported until 2027-08-31 and runs everywhere. Held there until an 8.0 patch starts on current kernels. Running 8.8.1 on 7.0 is outside Rocket.Chat's own matrix, which is the other half of this decision and the reason the review date is not far off.
